stories.title: Japan FA’s Kozo Tashima to stand against Infantino for Fifa presidency
summary: Tashima says he brings ‘honest, sound, upright attitude’He is understood to have acted with the blessing of UefaThe Japan Football Association’s honorary president, Kozo Tashima, ⁠has announced his intention to stand against Gianni Infantino in March’s Fifa presidential election.Tashima is the second challenger to declare in advance of the 18 November deadline after the former Tottenham defender Ramon Vega, although it remains unclear whether Vega has the backing of five of Fifa’s 211 member associations, which is required to take a place on the ballot in Rabat.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo calls time on Portugal career after 234 caps and 146 goals
summary: Player says that he will ‘hand back the No 7 shirt’Ronaldo ended up falling out with Jorge JesusCristiano Ronaldo has announced that he will not play for Portugal any more, ending an international career that spanned six World Cups and included a European title and the men’s all-time scoring record.The announcement marked the end of a lauded career that began more than two decades ago before Euro 2004 and finished with him walking out on the national team after falling out with coach Jorge Jesus.

stories.title: Fifa wants to restrict women’s Olympic football to under-23s in controversial move
summary: IOC open to dialogue and Fifa wants input from othersFifa concerned about fixture congestion and workload Fifa wants the International Olympic Committee to restrict the women’s Olympic football tournament to under-23s owing to concerns over fixture congestion and the workload of senior players.The eligibility criteria for the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles has been set, with qualification tournaments having begun in some regions, so no change can be made until Brisbane 2032 at the earliest, but sources at both organisations have told the Guardian that they are open to dialogue.

stories.title: FA and WSL launch major study into ACL injuries in women's football

stories.title: ‘In our veins’: Arsenal pushed by pain of Champions League final defeat, says Raya
summary: ‘On us to make it better this year,’ goalkeeper admitsHe credits self-belief as key to making decisive savesDavid Raya has said Arsenal are using the pain of losing on penalties against Paris Saint-Germain in last year’s Champions League final to “make it better this year”.The Spain goalkeeper produced an outstanding save to help Arsenal hold off Slavia Prague on Wednesday as Mikel Arteta’s side moved up to third in the league standings with 10 points from four matches.

stories.title: Sydney Swans engage external advisers to review embattled AFL club’s culture
summary: Club grappling with cultural problem after off-season incidentClub CEO Matthew Pavlich ‘bitterly disappointed’ in Tom PapleyThe Sydney Swans have engaged external advisers to review the embattled AFL club’s culture following the Melbourne hotel incident in August which led to the suspension of five players, and Tom Papley’s alleged positive roadside drug test this week.The Swans CEO, Matthew Pavlich, on Thursday expressed the club’s disappointment at being dragged into another off-season scandal after Papley, one of the team’s most experienced players, allegedly returned a positive result for methylamphetamine when pulled over by police on Monday morning.

The governing body would come under severe pressure to extend sanctions on European football’s pariah state, whose club and national teams are banned from competing in international tournaments.

stories.title: Australian F1 world champion Alan Jones dies aged 80
summary: Jones one of just two Australians to win F1 title after triumph in 1980He won 12 grands prix across 10 seasons before retirement in 1986 Alan Jones, the 1980 Formula One world champion, has died aged 80.Jones won 12 F1 grands prix across his career and became just the second Australian, after Sir Jack Brabham, to be crowned world champion when he claimed the title with Williams in 1980.

stories.title: ‘Playing out of his mind’: Novak Djokovic hails Rinky Hijikata after Australian’s stunning win in Paris
summary: Hijikata wins 2-6, 6-3, 6-3 to end Serb’s ATP Finals hopesHe becomes just fourth Australian to conquer DjokovicRinky Hijikata has revealed he almost didn’t even take the court before notching the biggest win of his career to send the great Novak Djokovic crashing out of ATP Finals contention.Continuing his inspired run from qualifying, Hijikata lit up the indoor Plenitude Arena to bring down Djokovic 2-6, 6-3, 6-3 to surge into the Paris Masters third round.

stories.title: LIV Golf’s attempted relaunch collapses after new lead investor withdraws, reports say
summary: BC Partners reportedly walks away after player exodusLIV set to appear at bankruptcy hearing on ThursdayThe rebel LIV Golf tour’s attempt to relaunch itself after filing for bankruptcy has collapsed following the withdrawal of the new lead investor BC Partners, according to reports on Wednesday.The private capital firm made the decision to walk away after struggling to convince several star players to commit fully to the league going forward, the Financial Times and the Athletic reported, citing anonymous sources.
